task_name: receiver-antenna phase-centre correction from a published calibration block
note: Every criterion is a question about the agent's PROCESS, derived from TRUTH.md. `channel` decides who answers it: `deterministic` -> a pytest of the same id in verifier/test_trajectory.py; `non_deterministic` -> the LLM judge. `is_positive:false` marks a guardrail; guardrail weights are negative by design (the doctrine constrains magnitude, not sign). TRUTH.md is answer-free; no criterion is graded against a ground-truth value.
weight_doctrine: abs(weight) in {5,3,1,0}. 5 = the crux the task exists to measure. 3 = a step whose omission changes the answer beyond tolerance. 1 = a step that is necessary but not discriminating, or a narration criterion (capped at 1 by P-06). 0 = recorded only.

criteria.criterion: OUTCOME CHANNEL. A final answer exists and is well formed: re-derived from this run's OWN trajectory by probe re-execution (the authored solver is reconstructed with its edits replayed in order, its hardcoded paths are rewritten into a sandbox over the shipped inputs, and it is executed; a literal answer-file write is the fallback), it parses, and it carries every graded case as a finite number under the task's declared output contract.
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural role: the outcome channel's shape check. Weight 3 (contract conformance, outcome-breaking): a correct calculation serialised outside the declared contract scores zero on the reward instrument. Route-independent - it grades the answer's shape, never how the answer was reached, and it is satisfied by a solver in any language or by a hand-written answer file. Not a nested duplicate of R2: the separating trajectory is the common one that emits a well-formed answer with a wrong value, which fails the tolerance criterion alone.

criteria.criterion: OUTCOME CHANNEL, GATE. Every graded case of the re-derived answer lands inside the task's own tolerance against the frozen truth. The answer is re-derived from this run's own trajectory by probe re-execution, never read from a reward file, so the instrument is standalone.
criteria.weight_evidence: GATE, weight 5: this is the outcome itself, and REQ-9 requires the wrong-answer gate (OUTCOME-FAILED) to cap final at 0.5 exactly as CRUX-FAILED does. The reference and the tolerance are the task's own frozen, control-measured values in verifier/expected_values.json - not a value invented for the rubric. Route-independent by construction: it reads only the answer, so every correct route satisfies it. Outcome mass is deliberately modest (8 of the rubric's total weight mass) - the channel's authority is the gate, not the mass.

criteria.criterion: The agent opened the shipped sightlines.csv or question.json rather than working only from the prose task.
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural role: necessary to attempt the task at all, but both arms do it, so it does not discriminate. The case list is the only place the twelve directions exist.

criteria.criterion: The agent authored a solver (a file write or a python heredoc/-c) rather than emitting numbers directly.
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural role: evidence the answer was computed, not asserted. Non-discriminating between arms.

criteria.criterion: The agent executed python (the answer was computed, not asserted).
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural role: pairs with R4 as the effort floor (R-16). Non-discriminating.

criteria.criterion: THE crux against the no-skill route. The run reads a per-antenna calibration block and takes both the offset vector and the variation grid out of it, rather than manufacturing a correction from the nominal vector supplied for orientation.
criteria.weight_evidence: Measured control: the no-skill route in the ledger (nominal_offset_without_variation) misses by 92.71x tolerance at its closest case, and reporting nothing at all misses by 550.60x, both recomputed live into verifier/expected_values.json control_gaps. This single step accounts for the whole measured separation between arms.

criteria.criterion: DISTINCTNESS INCREMENT. Given that a calibration block was consulted at all - which is R6's question, not this one - a DISTINCT block is resolved for each antenna rather than one block applied to all three. What this criterion grades is the per-antenna resolution and nothing else.
criteria.weight_evidence: Measured control: other_antenna_calibration misses by 373.00x tolerance at its closest case. The three vertical offsets span most of a decimetre at the primary carrier. MUTUAL EXCLUSIVITY (Stage 2 rule 7), NESTED SUBSET FOUND: _qc/criterion_independence.py finds no fixture in the shipped suite that fails R6 (the weight-5 gate) without also failing this criterion - failing the broader guarantees failing the narrower - while five fixtures fail this one with the gate passing, so the row stands. RE-TIERED 3 -> 1: at 3 beside a gate of 5, the no-block route lost 8 units of channel mass on the single fact of whether a calibration block was consulted. The text is re-scoped so what it grades is the increment, and the tier prices that increment rather than the crux a second time.

criteria.criterion: The frequency section is addressed by the three-character carrier code the case names, rather than one section being reused across carriers.
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural: the offset vectors of the four carriers used here differ by up to several centimetres on one antenna, which is one to three orders of magnitude beyond tolerance, so a fixed section changes the answer on every case that is not its own.

criteria.criterion: The variation grid is indexed by the zenith angle, obtained by subtracting the elevation from a right angle, rather than by the elevation itself.
criteria.weight_evidence: Measured NON-discriminating on this case set: elevation_used_as_zenith_angle spans 0.34x to 97.69x tolerance and therefore fails the 2x floor on at least one case, so it is recorded in verifier/expected_values.json non_separating_routes rather than in the control ledger. Weight 1 rather than 3 for exactly that reason.

criteria.criterion: The interpolated variation is added to the projected offset with the sign the table carries.
criteria.weight_evidence: Measured control: pco_projection_without_variation misses by 22.21x tolerance at its closest case and variation_subtracted_instead_of_added by 44.42x, both recomputed live into control_gaps. Every case was drawn where the variation is at least a millimetre, so the term is load-bearing by construction.

criteria.criterion: The run emitted phase_centre_correction_mm at the declared path in the declared shape.
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural role: a run that cannot be parsed cannot be scored. Both arms satisfy it, so it does not discriminate.

criteria.criterion: The offset vector was projected onto the line of sight: a unit vector towards the satellite is built in the local north/east/up frame from the azimuth (clockwise from north) and the elevation, and combined with the offset by a dot product. Any equivalent construction counts - an explicit dot product, a sum of component-wise products, or a spherical formula that expands to the same thing.
criteria.weight_evidence: Outcome-breaking (weight 3), and coverage of TRUTH.md Step 3, which no criterion reached before (REQ-9 collective exhaustiveness). The projection is one of the two terms the graded correction is the sum of, so omitting it or building the sight vector with the azimuth measured from the wrong reference moves every graded case. Not 5: the crux gate is R6 - obtaining the antenna's own block is what separates the no-skill route - and this step is ordinary geometry the prompt pins. Distinct evidence from R9 (the grid index, Step 4) and R10 (the sum, Step 5): a run can fail exactly one of the three. DEMOTED TO REPORT-ONLY (weight 3 -> 0), and the reason is not mutual exclusivity but the bar that precedes it: _qc/criterion_independence.py finds this criterion firing on ALL SIXTEEN shipped fixtures INCLUDING the clean GOOD run, whose solver reaches `np.dot(pco, e)` without spelling out the cos/sin construction of `e` that the detector's first conjunct demands. A check that fires on the correct fixture has no discrimination and would subtract from faithful runs, which REQ-9 forbids a criterion from doing at all - so it must not carry weight while that is true. It keeps its row, its truth_ref and its detector, so Step 3 remains covered for rule 8 and the firing table still records it. It earns weight 3 back when it stays quiet on a correct run: either the detector accepts a projection whose unit vector was built upstream or in a helper, or the clean fixture is written out in full. Neither file is this rubric's to change.

criteria.criterion: GUARDRAIL: the run read /oracle, /verifier, expected_values.json, golden.json or truth.md.
criteria.weight_evidence: Invalidating by charter (R-12): reward obtained this way is not a measurement. Magnitude matches the crux because it voids the run entirely.

criteria.criterion: GUARDRAIL: the run injected a conftest, edited or deleted a test, or wrote under the verifier path.
criteria.weight_evidence: Invalidating by charter (R-13). Same magnitude and for the same reason as answer-path access.

criteria.criterion: GUARDRAIL: the run attempted to fetch a calibration file or any other input over the network.
criteria.weight_evidence: Structural: the environment declares no-network, so an attempt cannot succeed. Weighted below the invalidating pair because a blocked attempt is a fairness signal, not a completed leak.

criteria.criterion: NARRATION: the run states that the phase-centre pattern belongs to the antenna model and cannot be derived from the line-of-sight geometry.
criteria.weight_evidence: P-06 caps narration at 1: articulating the constraint is a speech act any style-tuned model can emit, and the no-skill arm can state it correctly while still failing the crux.

criteria.criterion: NARRATION: the run identifies the nominal offset supplied for orientation as orientation rather than as the basis for the answer.
criteria.weight_evidence: P-06 narration cap. Recorded for R-21 distractor-engagement attribution; it does not move the outcome.

mece: REQ-9: the criterion set is MECE across the outcome and process instruments jointly. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE - no two criteria are decided by the same evidence; for every pair there is a trajectory that fails exactly one, argued in each criterion's weight_evidence. The deliberate exception is a d_ criterion and its judged twin on the same subject: they rest on different evidence (what the code did vs. what the reasoning earned) and are separable in both directions. COLLECTIVELY EXHAUSTIVE - see the `coverage` block. THREE CHANNELS - `outcome` (o_*: pytest that re-derives the final answer by probe re-execution of the run's own solver), `deterministic` (d_*: mechanics over the trajectory), `non_deterministic` (n_*: the judged rubric) - blended by weight mass with TWO gates capping identically at 0.5: CRUX-FAILED and OUTCOME-FAILED.

mutual_exclusivity_review.note: VERIFIER_PIPELINE Stage 2 rule 7 audit, corroborated by _qc/criterion_independence.py over the 16 fixtures in verification/negative_fixtures_test.py. Operative test: can a run fail exactly one of the two criteria? Nothing was deleted.

pairs.separating_trajectory: Five fixtures fail R7 while the gate passes - one antenna's block used for all three. No fixture fails the gate without also failing R7, which is the nesting.
pairs.action: R7 3 -> 1, text re-scoped to the per-antenna increment.

pairs.separating_trajectory: Exists but is not in the suite: a run that loads all three antenna blocks and reads the L1 section for an L2 case fails R8 alone. The predicates read different evidence - ANT-A/B/C labels vs. three-character carrier codes - and every negative fixture is terse enough to miss both, which is why the columns coincide. A fixture-suite work item, not duplicated weight.
None: the criterion fires on all 16 fixtures INCLUDING the clean GOOD run. Before a criterion can be independent it has to be quiet on a correct run.
pairs.action: weight 3 -> 0, report_only, reason recorded in its weight_evidence. Row, truth_ref and detector kept.

pairs.separating_trajectory: A run that authors the solver and never runs it fails R5 alone; the suite has no such fixture.
No d_ criterion reads a graded correction value; each reads the route.

coverage.note: REQ-9 collective exhaustiveness / VERIFIER_PIPELINE Stage 2 rule 8: every TRUTH.md heading must be named by at least one criterion's truth_ref across the union of the three channels, or appear here with a reason. Exhaustiveness is assessed over the union of channels, never per channel. A step no criterion reaches is instrument blindness, and in a score artifact blindness is indistinguishable from coverage - so the uncovered list ships as a named artifact rather than being left to be rediscovered.

uncheckable.reason: Container heading for the numbered steps beneath it; every step it contains is named by a criterion in its own right.
